summary: Warren County Public Schools opposes the elimination of the E-Rate Program, emphasizing its critical role in providing broadband services and equipment for schools and libraries. The school district urges the FCC to reject any proposal that would terminate or limit the E-Rate Program, citing the financial and logistical challenges it would pose. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, citing concerns about overreach into local instructional autonomy and increased costs for schools and libraries.
